articles.title: GHSA: plone.app.event vulnerable to denial of service via iCalendar import
articles.summary:
### Impact
By abusing the iCalendar import functionality, a logged-in editor could take the whole site offline, make the server reach into the internal network and read calendar files off disk (SSRF), and store XSS.

The problem has been patched in `plone.app.event`.

articles.title: GHSA: Yamcs vulnerable to authenticated remote code execution via unescaped StreamSQL `LIKE` pattern compiled by Janino (`LikeExpression`)
articles.summary:
## Summary
Yamcs compiles StreamSQL query expressions to Java at runtime with Janino. The `LIKE` operator inserts the user-supplied pattern into the generated Java **unescaped**, inside a `"..."` literal, so a pattern containing `"` breaks out and injects arbitrary Java (e.g. a `static{}` block that runs an OS command when the compiled filter class loads). Result: RCE as the OS user running Yamcs.
